title: docs(onboarding): template-distribution.md's Option A gh api fetch loop has no ?ref=, resolving the mutable default branch
body:
**Origin**: flagged by a Copilot review comment on `kurone-kito/dotfiles`#383's PR (the `v0.9.0` re-import round), carried forward unfixed to `v0.11.0`, reconfirmed by dotfiles#425's final-verification sweep.

**File**: `idd-template/docs/onboarding/template-distribution.md`, "Option A" `gh api` fetch loop.

**Problem**: The fetch loop queries:

```
repos/kurone-kito/idd-skill/contents/idd-template/${FILE}
```

with no `?ref=<tag-or-commit>` query parameter, so it resolves whatever the source repository's default branch (`main`) currently is at fetch time, rather than a pinned tag/commit. This contradicts the same file's own "keep imports pinned to a released tag or commit" guidance that applies everywhere else in the document.

**Suggested fix**: Add `?ref=<pinned-tag-or-commit>` to the `contents` API call, with a placeholder the adopter fills in from their own recorded pin (mirroring how the rest of the document handles pinning).

**Confirmed present** at `v0.11.0` verbatim (`idd-template/docs/onboarding/template-distribution.md`, ~line 336).
